title: Gentle cell extraction from rocks for downstream single cell sorting and sequencing
author: Jackie Goordial
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bvrmn546

steps.title: Add EDTA to rock suspension
steps.instruction: Add EDTA to a 15 mL tube that already contains 5 mL glyTE and 5 g crushed rock, adjusting the volume so that the final EDTA concentration is 10 mM.

steps.title: Vortex tubes horizontally
steps.instruction: Place two tubes side‑by‑side in the tube holder of a Vortex‑Genie‑2 and vortex horizontally for 5 minutes at speed setting 7 (avoid higher speeds to prevent cell damage from rock particles).

steps.title: Ice‑water sonication
steps.instruction: Sonicate the two tubes simultaneously while they are immersed in ice‑water for 1 minute.

steps.title: Low‑speed centrifugation and supernatant transfer
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes at 1,000 RPM for 5 minutes to pellet rock particles, then carefully transfer the supernatant to a fresh 15 mL Falcon tube.

steps.title: High‑speed centrifugation of supernatant
steps.instruction: Aliquot the supernatant into two 2 mL centrifuge tubes (one for sorting, one for microscopy) and centrifuge each at 10,000 RPM for 5 minutes. After the spin, gently remove the supernatant with a pipette (do not pour off). Repeat the centrifugation a second time under the same conditions; after the two rounds, approximately 2.5 mL of material will be pelleted in each tube (≈2 mL first spin, ≈250 µL second spin).

substeps.instruction: Load 2 mL of supernatant into each of two 2 mL tubes.
Pipette off the supernatant carefully; do not pour.
Repeat centrifugation at 10,000 RPM for another 5 minutes.
Pipette off the remaining supernatant, leaving the pellet.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet for cell sorting
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet from the tube designated for sorting in 1 mL of 1X glyTE (optionally dilute with 1X PBS) and store the suspension in a freezer.

steps.title: Prepare microscopy sample
steps.instruction: Stain the pellet from the microscopy tube with SYBR Green, filter the stained suspension onto a 0.2 µm polycarbonate filter, rinse and air‑dry the filter, then mount it on a glass slide using Citifluor antifade mounting solution. Count cells immediately or store the slide at 4 °C until counting.

substeps.instruction: Add SYBR Green stain to the pellet and incubate as recommended.
Filter the stained suspension onto a 0.2 µm polycarbonate filter.
Rinse the filter with sterile water or buffer.
Mount the dried filter on a glass slide with Citifluor antifade mounting solution.
Either count cells now or store the slide at 4 °C until counting.
